description: Export a drawbell extraction schedule to a specified table. A table is a list of x,y pairs that can be plotted, exported and queried with FISH . See Table for more details about tables in MassFlow . In these tables, x is the period and y is the mass.

keywords.name: cumulative
keywords.description: If set to true , then the cumulative mass is recorded. The default is false , such that the mass for each period is recorded.

keywords.name: drawpoint
keywords.description: If this keyword is not given, the default is the sum of the mass for all drawpoints.

keywords.name: name
keywords.description: Specify a name for the table.

notes: `name` is required: without it the command fails with `MASSFLOW DRAWPOINT DUMP-SCHEDULE: Table not be created`.

On MassFlow 9.7.47 this creates the named table but leaves it EMPTY. Tried on a model computed to day 50, with and without `drawpoint`, with and without `cumulative on`: `table list` reports 0 entries every time. Use `massflow record` for a mass-per-period table that does fill.
